verdict.summary: SPEC-0336: fixed this loop's review findings. Frame writes no longer block (select-gated PIPE_BUF writes that give up on cancel, a signal or a stall). The finish gc runs detached so a job's exit never waits on it. `.`/`..` names are refused at validate. ssh-command is now tested through the CLI and with only execvp patched.

old worker.py restored: uv run pytest -q -n 6 tests/test_worker.py -k 'nobody_reads or stalled or finish_gc or bad_header' (all 8 new cases fail, as expected)

ac_status.ac: gate-job runs sent gates, emits accepted/started/gate/done with files
env outside allowlist -> validate error; reused job_id -> claim
concurrent jobs with different base.sha see their own base
EOF mid-gate / during slot wait -> done interrupted
log over 16 MiB truncated with truncated_bytes
have after job; gc --keep-days 0 removes refs/objects/dirs except live job
ssh-command execs the four allowed subcommands, refuses others with exit 2
WORKFLOW.md documents dedicated user and key line

followup_ideas: The detached finish gc can run concurrently from many jobs finishing together; a non-blocking gc.lock to skip a gc while another is running would avoid redundant scans.
_drop_job_refs at job finish still waits on the job's own repo lock (behind another job's bundle fetch for the same repo); it could move to the detached gc, which already drops orphan job refs.
